blocks.text: Print 1 to 15, but multiples of 3 print Fizz, of 5 print Buzz, of both FizzBuzz. The trap is order: check the combined case first, or it never runs.

Validate input with guard clauses before the business logic. grade('90') returning 'Invalid' is deliberate: silently accepting strings would let '90' + 10 bugs through later.

The two-pointer loop is O(n) time and O(1) extra space and exits on the first mismatch. The shorter clean === [...clean].reverse().join('') also works but allocates two extra copies; interviewers often ask for the pointer version as a follow-up.
